baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled qawm at words 1 and 7, kana at word 6, and fasiqin at word 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first qawm identifies the named body and the predicative second qawm makes collective identity itself carry f-s-q. K-w-n extends that characterization through time, while f-s-q supplies the concrete motion of moist fruit leaving its peel.

activation_trace.role: The literal human collective, repeated as identification and predicate, makes the social body the mechanism's subject.
Occurrence and presence in time turn the adjective from an isolated act into the group's attested condition.
Fruit leaving its peel gives the collective predicate a bounded-inside to exposed-outside motion.

changed_reading.after: The ayah characterizes the named social body, over time and as a body, by a constitutive movement out of a containing limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Min qablu at word 4 positions Noah's people before another point of reference.
baseline_models.mechanism: Q-b-l makes anteriority more than a date: what advances earlier in the sequence can also be mentally faced. The ayah presents this qawm as a predecessor brought forward for encounter.

activation_trace.role: Temporal advance directly grounds the people as an earlier member of an ordered sequence.
The branch's face-to-face image lets the earlier case function as a confronted precedent rather than inert chronology.
The named collective is the unit moved forward in the sequence.

changed_reading.after: Their anteriority presents a whole earlier collective as a precedent now made present for comparison.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah repeats qawm around a predicate whose only supplied f-s-q image is rupture of a casing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A qawm is not only a collection but can activate qiwam, the support and system by which something stands. Predicating shell-exit of that same body permits an exploratory reading in which the community's supporting order has failed to contain its members.

activation_trace.role: Support, system, and means of subsistence recast the doubled qawm as an order that should hold communal life together.
The fruit's exit from its peel supplies failure of containment within that social support.

changed_reading.before: A collection of individuals committed violations.
changed_reading.after: The collective's own qiwam is implicated: its defining condition is a breach of the order by which a people stands.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sent message and disclosed sign meet turning-away into a strong supporting side; a mutually supporting troop then shares the leader's casting-out. Against the doubled qawm, collective f-s-q becomes a social conversion in which backing stabilizes refusal and distributes its consequence.

activation_trace.role: The human collective anchors the claim that refusal becomes a group condition.
Exit from a peel supplies the focus motion that the context turns into socially reinforced departure.
Messenger and message supply the external address from which refusal departs.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes the address available rather than hidden.
Turning the back supplies the first directional refusal in the contextual mechanism.
A strong side leaned upon makes refusal institutionally supported rather than solitary.
The mutually supporting troop turns the leader's stance into a collective formation.
Literal throwing-out reverses agency: the formation that turned out from the message is itself cast out.

structural_cues: 51:38-40 runs from sent disclosure, through turning away with a supporting side, to leader and troops being cast together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message, disclosure, reliance, troops, and joint casting; I infer that backing converts a leader's refusal into a qawm-wide condition and consequence. The live alternative is that the troops share punishment without helping produce the refusal.

changed_reading.before: F-s-q is an aggregate label for individual misconduct.
changed_reading.after: F-s-q can name a socially reinforced exit: collective support hardens refusal, after which the supporting formation shares the leader's outward casting.

context_deltas.mechanism: Insolence away from command is followed by inability to perform qiyam, immediately before qawm and kana recur in the focus. The context therefore makes f-s-q's chosen exit the moral inverse of standing: departure from governing order ends in loss of capacity to rise as a people.

activation_trace.role: Bodily standing latent in qawm supplies the vertical capacity reversed by f-s-q.
Exit from the casing supplies the outward motion opposed to maintained standing.
Insolence away from obedience identifies the voluntary side of the reversal.
Binding demand supplies the governing line from which the contextual people depart.
Capacity and ability mark the resulting inability to recover a standing position.
Explicit qiyam realizes bodily rising one verse before qawm repeats the same root.
The repeated temporal copula binds the inability-to-stand clause tightly to the focus characterization.

structural_cues: The adjacent sequence is refusal of command, seizure while seeing, inability of qiyam, then kana plus doubled qawm and fasiqin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command-refusal, failed qiyam, and the adjacent q-w-m/k-w-n echo; I assign the causal reversal from chosen noncompliance to lost standing. A live alternative is that 51:45 only reports punishment and does not anatomize f-s-q.

changed_reading.before: Fasiqin reports a settled moral classification.
changed_reading.after: It also traces anti-qiyam: a people's exit from governing command becomes inability to stand, making the doubled qawm internally reversible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the breached qawm come joined construction, supporting force, prepared ground, and paired composition. This coherent made order strengthens the exploratory qiwam baseline: the people are a composite support whose defining shell-exit contrasts with a world held together and made habitable.

activation_trace.role: Qiwam as support and system lets the social collective be tested against the following constructed order.
The casing breach supplies the local failure of containment.
Building by joining parts supplies a stable composite that contrasts with social de-composition.
Supporting force gives the constructed whole the strength that the failed qiwam lacks.
Preparing and leveling an affair adds ordered habitability to the constructive contrast.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies relational composition rather than isolated parts.

structural_cues: 51:47-49 pivots immediately from the focus people to building, spreading, and creating in pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate sequence of joined building, force, preparation, and pairing; I analogize cosmic composition to communal qiwam and read f-s-q as its breach. The live alternative is a clean topic shift with no social-material contrast.

changed_reading.before: The qawm is merely the population to which the adjective applies.
changed_reading.after: The qawm can be heard as failed social architecture: a support made of relations whose contents no longer remain within its ordering bounds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch pictures outward movement, but 51:50 commands another outward movement with an explicit destination. Flight toward God distinguishes saving departure from f-s-q: motion out is not sufficient to define rebellion; relation, warning, and destination determine its valence.

activation_trace.role: Fruit leaving a peel supplies morally underdetermined outward geometry for the comparison.
Literal flight supplies a commanded counter-exit rather than static compliance.
The worshipped one is the named destination that gives flight its saving direction.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the pressure under which a rightly directed exit becomes urgent.

structural_cues: The imperative has an explicit ila destination and follows the focus by four verses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shell-exit, commanded flight, destination, and warning; I infer that direction and relation distinguish f-s-q from rescue. The live alternative is that the f-s-q image is only lexical background and should not be spatially paired with flight.

changed_reading.before: F-s-q means crossing outward from a prescribed boundary.
changed_reading.after: The problem is misdirected exit, not movement itself: the pericope answers departure from order with an urgent departure toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Qabl recurs in a claim that earlier recipients repeat the same anti-messenger speech, followed by a question about mutual bequest and the answer that they are a qawm exceeding bounds. Noah's people become an early node in a reproducible collective script, while tughyan's limit-crossing and water-overflow sharpen f-s-q's shell-exit.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence first places Noah's people at the head of the later recurrence.
Exit from a casing supplies the focus's material form of boundary crossing.
The repeated temporal branch expands Noah's anteriority into a class of earlier recipients.
Messenger and message provide the stable object against which the recurring response forms.
Speech spreading among people supplies a repeatable public script rather than a private reaction.
Mutual bequest gives the rhetorical hypothesis of transmission across collectives.
The repeated collective noun identifies the scale at which the pattern recurs.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience gives the direct moral geometry that sharpens f-s-q.
Water overflowing its bounds supplies the non-dominant mapped root's material analogue for collective excess.

structural_cues: 51:52 repeats the earlier-people construction and the paired accusations already seen in 51:39; 51:53 asks about transmission, then substitutes collective tughyan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated wording, a rhetorical transmission question, qawm, and two limit-crossing branches; I infer structural recurrence rather than literal intergenerational counsel. The live alternative is simply independent groups making similar choices.

changed_reading.before: Noah's people are one old example of disobedience.
changed_reading.after: They are an early realization of a recurrent qawm-level script: public refusal reproduces itself as collective overflow beyond a limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending gives wrongdoers a share like their companions' share, forbids haste, and names an appointed promised day. This converts min qablu from bare chronology into distributive order: Noah's qawm is an earlier cohort whose outcome becomes the measured analogue for later companions.

activation_trace.role: Precedence places the focus people earlier in the ordered distribution.
The collective is the cohort to which the analogous outcome attaches.
An allotted share makes consequence distributive and measured rather than merely repetitive.
Likeness and counterpart relation tie a later allotment to an earlier analogue.
Companionship groups separated peoples into cohorts sharing the same patterned outcome.
Haste and premature advance make waiting part of the temporal mechanism.
The day's event and severity provide the terminal time toward which the ordered cohorts move.
An appointment fixing promise to time or place closes the sequence with a scheduled endpoint.

structural_cues: The final two ayat combine an analogous share, companions, prohibition of haste, and a promised day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies share, likeness, companionship, delay, and appointment; I infer that qabl orders cohorts within a measured recurrence. The live alternative is that only punishments are similar and the focus's qabl remains a simple date marker.

changed_reading.before: Before only locates Noah's people in the past.
changed_reading.after: Before enrolls them as an earlier cohort in a timed distribution whose analogous share awaits later companion-groups.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant s-m-m mapping of the contextual s-m-w root and a cross-domain geometric analogy. It remains valid because f-s-q explicitly supplies content exiting a casing and the next ayah supplies both an aperture image and joined construction. Render it only as exploratory material resonance, never as a lexical gloss of sama or qawm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Fasiqin at word 8 supplies an inside-to-outside casing breach.

activation_trace.role: The fruit exits its peel, establishing outward passage through a failed boundary.
A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies the inverse, regulated direction of passage.
Joined construction provides the bounded structure within which directional permeability matters.

changed_reading.before: The people cross a moral boundary.
changed_reading.after: Their failure can be pictured as inverse boundary permeability: a contained part exits its casing against a nearby built order whose apertures regulate entry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus predicate to the pericope's final k-f-r through two branch-level fruit-cover images. It remains anchored in the explicit f-s-q peel-exit and the cited k-f-r covering branches. Render it as a reciprocal material analogy, not as a claim that f-s-q and k-f-r are synonyms or strict opposites.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The supplied branch for fasiqin at word 8 is the moist fruit emerging from its peel.

activation_trace.role: Fruit emerging from its peel makes exposure by outward rupture the focus image.
Fruit coverings return the same material domain at the pericope's final moral designation.
Covering the truth bridges the fruit-cover image back to the final designation's moral operation.

changed_reading.before: Fasiqin and kafaru are cumulative labels for broadly similar wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The pericope permits reciprocal cover mechanics: one label pictures content bursting out of its cover, while the last pictures covering that hides truth.

strongest_changes: The qiyam and kana echo in 51:45 turns f-s-q into anti-standing: chosen departure from command culminates in inability to rise.
The repeated qabl construction and qawm taghun in 51:52-53 turn Noah's people into an early instance of a recurrent collective overflow script.
The allotted share, companions, delay, and promised day in 51:59-60 make anteriority an ordered cohort relation rather than bare chronology.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled qawm and the packet's single concrete f-s-q branch made the focus unusually responsive to social-body mechanics: support, containment, standing, construction, overflow, and even a saving counter-exit remained simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: The architecture and aperture readings depend on cross-domain branch analogy rather than focus syntax.
The packet cannot decide whether collective backing causes refusal or only shares its consequence.
Flight toward God as a counter-exit is directionally coherent, but f-s-q may function conventionally without activating spatial motion.
